reports.description:
This is a massive scam. Not only are they taking your money, but also your personal details which results in a very high risk of identity fraud. It has been one of the most stressful times as Ive had to go through everything and cancel things, add extra layers of protection etc. 
_x000D_
I was lead through a website that was advertising the app BitQT, was phoned and emailed by Washington Taylor and Timothy West (very certain they are false names) from Ripple-Markets, and lead to the website xrpm.io. As youd expect, the guy on the phone was lovely and super charming..._x000D_
_x000D_
But DONT BE DECEIVED - They take your money and details of your identity and they dont give it back._x000D_
_x000D_
I emailed Timothy the day after signing up asking for a full refund as set out in their terms and conditions, but have just been blanked. They have been reported - please please please report them to the police if you are scammed by them._x000D_
_x000D_
I dont know if its okay to say this on another review website, but I would highly recommend reading the business transparency page on Trustpilot for this business - theyve flagged almost all of their negative reviews. Im not surprised, why would they want the public to know they scam people?

reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: investment scram
reports.description: Beurax was a pyramid scam that provided good profits if you invest with them. They said you can start with $20 and make a profit of hundreds of thousands of dollars, the same was if you wanted to invest in BTC which I was interested in. I started with $100 because over time everything seemed normal for me and my friend, we invested a larger amount of money. They promised a 1,8% return on investments Monday-Friday for a twenty-day period payment plan, and you couldn‚Äôt withdraw your money for 20 working days from the time you deposit. For us, this company seemed legit as it had regulations from ASIC in Australia. Then everything went wrong, we could withdraw our daily profits and the company re-invested it without our consideration. Then we contacted support they said we should not worried and our money will be with us by April. After a few weeks the website went down and we had no access to it anymore. Then I found Noblefxoption on the internet then a lady with 3 different names (Alicia, Tacy Carly FX and Charlotte) contacted me, said she has 5 years‚Äô experience in trading. I first deposited $153 in BTC and she was trading for me, for 7 days. After 7 days I checked my profile and I made s good amount of profit. Then the trade was over and I was required to pay the withdraw fees and taxes. When I paid the fees, I saw I didn‚Äôt include the transaction fees to the final fees and I wrote immediately to their support and said I‚Äôll send it separately. They said because of this I cannot withdraw it for more 48 hours. Alicia told me she`ll keep trading for me to have more profits. When 48 hours gone, I wanted to withdraw my money, Alicia said I only have to pay now for the broker fees. When I paid this fee, she told me I have to pay for more fees which I didn‚Äôt agree to. I realized by that time I have been scammed.
